column8: Evidence

column4: Is there a designated officer for NIS2 compliance?
column8: NIS2 Compliance Officer appointed and board-ratified (Group CISO, ref GOV-NIS2-2025-01); pre-registration pack prepared for NCSC portal.

column4: Does the board explicitly approve cyber measures?
column8: Board Risk & Cyber Committee charter BRC-CHTR-2025; cyber a standing board agenda item; measures approved in BM-2026-Q1.

column4: Is there an approved cyber budget for 18 months?
column8: Cyber programme funded on a rolling annual capital cycle (FIN-CAP-2026); 18-month forward commitment not yet formally minuted.

column4: Do board members undergo mandatory cyber training?
column8: Mandatory board cyber-governance training completed 2026-01 (LMS-BOARD-2026-01, 100% completion).

column4: Is there a documented Security Policy (ISMS)?
column8: ISO/IEC 27001-aligned ISMS policy suite ISMS-POL v4.1, certified scope covers core clinical systems; owner Group CISO.

column4: Does policy cover all NIS2 risk areas?
column8: Policy coverage matrix POL-MAP-2026 maps every Art.21(2) area and all 16 NCSC RMMs to an owned policy.

column4: Are risk assessments conducted annually?
column8: Annual enterprise risk assessment RA-2026-ACAD (ISO 27005), refreshed quarterly for high-risk research systems.

column4: Are critical assets (e.g., EHR) formally identified?
column8: Critical Asset Register CAR-2026 v3.0; EHR, PACS, LIS, ePMA, research HPC classified; owner IT Asset Manager.

column4: Are measures audited/tested annually?
column8: Independent internal audit IA-CYBER-2026-02 and annual third-party penetration test PEN-2026-01 on record.

column4: Is there a process to update measures post-incident?
column8: Post-incident review standard PROC-IR-004 v2.0; lessons-learned feed control updates (PIR register 2025-2026).

column4: Is patching performed within defined SLAs?
column8: Risk-based patch SLA policy ITS-STD-007 v2.1 (critical 72h, high 14d); Tenable + WSUS/Intune compliance >95%.

column4: Are backups tested for restorability annually?
column8: Quarterly backup restore tests BKP-RESTORE-2026-Q1/Q2; immutable backups; owner Infrastructure Lead.

column4: Is cyber hygiene training mandatory for all staff?
column8: Security awareness mandatory; completion 88% (LMS-RPT-2026-05); rolling enforcement for remaining clinical staff.

column4: Is the asset inventory up-to-date?
column8: CMDB (ServiceNow) strong for IT; networked medical devices/OT only ~70% inventoried (MDS-GAP-2026-01).

column4: Are background checks performed for sensitive roles?
column8: Garda vetting and pre-employment screening register HR-VET-2026 for clinical/privileged roles.

column4: Are access rights revoked immediately upon exit?
column8: Automated joiner-mover-leaver via IGA (SailPoint); leaver deprovisioning SLA <2h; sample SNOW-LVR-2026.

column4: Is MFA enforced for ALL remote/admin access?
column8: Enterprise MFA (Entra ID + FIDO2) enforced for all remote and privileged access; coverage report IAM-RPT-2026-06 = 100%.

column4: Is 'Least Privilege' strictly enforced?
column8: PAM (CyberArk) for privileged accounts; least-privilege RBAC recertified quarterly PAR-2026-Q1.

column4: Are physical server rooms secured?
column8: Tier III data centres, badge + biometric access, environmental monitoring; audit FAC-ENV-2026.

column4: Is patient data encrypted at rest?
column8: Encryption at rest (TDE + full-disk) across clinical databases and endpoints; KMS-managed keys CRY-STD-005 v2.

column4: Is data encrypted in transit (TLS)?
column8: TLS 1.2/1.3 enforced (grade A, SSLSCAN-2026-05); mTLS for sensitive integrations.

column4: Do supplier contracts include security SLAs?
column8: Security schedules + right-to-audit in top-50 supplier contracts; standard NIS2 clause library LEG-CYB-2026.

column4: Are critical vendors risk-assessed?
column8: Top clinical vendors risk-assessed (TPRM-2026); academic research collaborators and grant-funded SaaS only partially covered.

column4: Is security built into system acquisition?
column8: Secure-by-design gate SDLC-CHK-009 applied to enterprise procurements; bespoke research/clinical-trial systems inconsistently gated.

column4: Is there a documented Incident Response Plan?
column8: Board-approved Incident Response Plan IRP-PLAN-006 v2.0; 24/7 SOC; playbooks for ransomware/EHR outage.

column4: Has the IRP been tested (tabletop) in 12 months?
column8: Two exercises in 12 months: ransomware tabletop TTX-2025-11 and live red-team RT-2026-02.

column4: Can you submit an 'Early Warning' within 24h?
column8: 24h early-warning runbook IRP-PROC-007 v2.0; named owner, on-call rota; validated test submission TEST-EW-2026-02.

column4: Are detection mechanisms (IDS/SIEM) in place?
column8: 24/7 SOC with Microsoft Sentinel SIEM + MDR; EDR on all endpoints; detection coverage report SOC-2026-Q2.

column4: Is there a Business Continuity Plan with RTOs?
column8: BCP BCP-PLAN-010 v2.0 with RTO/RPO for Tier 1 systems validated at main campus; satellite-site continuity not fully validated.

column4: Are DR procedures tested annually?
column8: Annual DR failover proven for primary data centre (DR-TEST-2026-03); full multi-site failover incl. medical devices not yet exercised end-to-end.
